A total disappointment!
Jun 2025 • Friends
I was here last year 2024 the food was amazing!!! It was worth every bite. 

Sadly 2025 it's a complete disappointment. It's definitely not worth the price!!! Each bite made me wonder "why?" I mean you could do it that way but why? 

The service was excellent!!! The hostess and the server were lovely, gentle, and very conscientious. But service alone did not save the meal. 

Please try again Tre. We want you back.

Wow... great place. I think will be our favorite restaurant in the future.

Location: view is great and up the road so not noisy
Decoration: great and the tables not to close to each other so you have some privacy
Staff: all very very friendly and explain the meals. Also gives you recommendations 
Price: fair for what you get

Yes.... we will be back

Nov 2023 • Friends

Service was absolutely wonderful without the servers being in your face. Impeccable presentation of food too.

I am looking forward to visiting again soon
